claims.claim: The Workbench is the single home route.
The landing composer accepts a long-form project request and creates a project.
Web submission enters InitialProjectRequest and starts the canonical Lead intake.
The trusted Workbench application delegates web actions to TrialEntryService and canonical workflow scope.
Lead is recorded as the first semantic owner.
Clarification answers resume the same durable project and rebuild the Lead state.
Brief approval and revision are rehydrated through Lead authority with currentness checks.
Planning approval runs Planner, Architecture Review, and Design through canonical services.
Database and dependency decisions use Phase 7C authority.
The Workbench requires exactly three Design Directions and uses canonical Design selection.
Implementation start is separately guarded and delegated to the Orchestrator task graph.
Allowed actions are derived from workflow state and current artifact evidence.
Project switching uses project IDs and server status reads; project lists are durable repository projections.
Refresh/resume reads the active project status from URL or local project ID.
The API boundary validates typed requests, caps payload size, and returns safe errors.
The browser calls only the local Workbench endpoint and exposes no provider credential path.
Conversation output is rendered as text and does not execute raw HTML.
No embedded website Preview or iframe was added.
CLI fallback commands remain in the accepted package configuration.
The production provider, telemetry, and full runtime composition remain the existing Factory path.
The Workbench candidate introduces no Codex provider.
The Workbench candidate introduces no database schema or migration file.
Only synthetic business data is used by the Workbench-focused test coverage.
The W1-W40 matrix passes in the focused Workbench test file.
The bounded browser flow covers landing, submit, Lead clarification, same-project resume, and no implementation start.
Focused and full deterministic validation results are recorded in the closure result.
